data.name: Jinaan
data.gender_notes: Jinaan is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'j-n-n', meaning 'pure'. In the Islamic context, it represents the state of being free from impurities, both physical and spiritual, leading to a serene and tranquil life. The name Jinaan carries the meaning “Purity, Serenity” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Jinaan usually hope their child will grow to embody purity, serenity and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Reflects the spiritual purity and inner peace granted by Allah (SWT) to the believers.
data.etymology: Jinaan belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Purity, Serenity.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jinaan total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_urdu.name: جنان
